title: The Wind in the Willows
author: Kenneth Grahame
blurb: Mole abandons his spring-cleaning, follows the call of the season out of doors, and meets the River for the first time.

title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
blurb: A bored Alice spots a waistcoated, watch-carrying White Rabbit and follows it down a very deep hole.

title: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
author: L. Frank Baum
blurb: Dorothy, Uncle Henry and Aunt Em watch a gray Kansas sky turn dangerous as a cyclone gathers over the prairie.

title: A Christmas Carol
author: Charles Dickens
blurb: Dickens establishes, beyond any doubt, that Marley is dead -- and introduces the tight-fisted Ebenezer Scrooge.
